response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM m) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_of_avg_unit_price, AVG(m.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(m.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_above_average FROM m CROSS JOIN a WHERE m.rate > a.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: A media type's bytes per millisecond is total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds across its tracks (ratio of sums), not the mean of per-track ratios.

The simple average across media types is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type rates. Only media types that have at least one track are included. Tracks with NULL Bytes add to the Milliseconds total but not to the Bytes total.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type's bytes per millisecond is the average of each track's Bytes/Milliseconds ratio.
